block-guide:
CORE/SOCIAL-LINK One icon inside core/social-links (never alone). Full guide: see core/social-links.
MARKUP: a self-closing comment, no HTML <!-- wp:social-link {"url":"https://www.instagram.com/example","service":"instagram"} /--> <!-- wp:social-link {"url":"hello@example.com","service":"mail","label":"Write to us"} /-->
ATTRIBUTES url: required; without it nothing is shown. An e-mail address becomes a mailto: link; an address without a scheme gets https:// added. service: the icon. Known slugs: amazon bandcamp behance bluesky chain codepen deviantart discord dribbble dropbox etsy facebook feed fivehundredpx flickr foursquare github goodreads google gravatar instagram lastfm linkedin mail mastodon medium meetup patreon pinterest pocket reddit share skype snapchat soundcloud spotify telegram threads tiktok tumblr twitch twitter vimeo vk whatsapp wordpress x yelp youtube. An unknown slug shows the generic "share" icon. chain = a plain link (a website); feed = RSS. label: the text for screen readers (or shown with showLabels); defaults to the service name. rel: extra rel values for the link.
